doc.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Wife Helen and his children
summary: He names his wife Helen and his five children, only Wayne in music.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: I’m remiss if I don’t ask this - the name of your wife, who passed away?
And all of your kids? As we know, Wayne, but I don’t know the names of the other...

I have an older daughter, LaTonya. Well the first one was Joe Jr., he’s the eldest. LaTonya, and then I had a son, Jeffrey, who passed away when he was twenty-one. And then another daughter, who lives down in Florida, Julia. And then Wayne.
Any of them follow the music business there, or go into music?
